content:
As Best Buy's 60th Anniversary Sale gets fully underway, this week's AirPods deals are even better — AirPods Pro 3 are still at one of their best prices ever, but we're also tracking AirPods Max 2 down $120, and AirPods 4 (ANC) at a new low in recent months. Today's 9to5Toys lunch-time express also includes the latest AirTag 2 back to all-time lows from $24 (or less) with 4-packs at $89; M5 Pro MacBook Pro limited-time $650 price drop; iPhone Air back to Black Friday pricing (down nearly $160, with up to $350 off open-box); and notable MacBook Neo deals. More below.

Summer AirPods deals keep getting better with up to $120 in savings

After a whole summer of deals on Apple's latest AirPods lineup, nearly all of them are going for even less cash now. The highly-celebrated AirPods Pro 3 are now 25% off at one of their lowest prices ever, but we're also seeing AirPods 4 (ANC) drop to a new low in recent months and AirPods Max 2 down another $120 earlier this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 (ANC) $135 (originally $179 new) — best price in 6 months
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)

Best Buy's 60th Anniversary Sale is officially live and giving Black Friday a run for its money with deals across Apple, LG TVs, Android, 10x rewards and more

Today's best chance to grab Apple's new AirTag 2 from just $20

Over the weekend, we spotted Amazon relaunching some of the lowest prices ever on Apple's all-new 2026 AirTag 2 trackers. The 4-pack is now shipping at an all-time low at $22 each, and with Best Buy's 60th Anniversary Sale in full swing, the single AirTag 2 has dropped to $24, while the open-box version is even cheaper at just $19.99. Details below.

As we mentioned over the weekend, Amazon has now discounted the Apple AirTag 2 4-pack down to $89 with free shipping. That's just around $22 per AirTag and is the best deal on brand-new units; but if you don't need 4, the single AirTag 2 is also now on sale.

Single unit originally $29 is now $24.99 at Amazon, with Best Buy taking things even further down to $24.

  • AirTag 2 $25 (originally $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 'Premium' open-box $20 (originally $29 new) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (originally $99)

Although we heavily expect Amazon to price match, at the time of writing Best Buy is indeed lower on the single unit.

Worth noting is Best Buy's 'Premium' open-box deal on the single unit — now as low as $19.99, which is the lowest price we've tracked. Saving an extra $4 versus new might not be worth it for everyone, but cheaper is cheaper, and this is the lowest price we've found at a reputable retailer at 69% of the original new MSRP.

AirPods Max 2 hit one of their best prices ever: $120 off in the 60th Anniversary Sale

iPhone Air (unlocked) returns to Black Friday pricing with nearly $160 off, up to $350 off open-box

Beyond the AirPods Pro 3 going for 75% of MSRP, the latest AirPods Max 2 down $120, and AirTag 2 back to low prices, Best Buy has also kicked off the 60th Anniversary Sale bringing back Black Friday pricing on the iPhone Air (unlocked, new).

With the 60th Anniversary Sale now in full swing, Best Buy is offering an extra $159 off unlocked new iPhone Air models across the board, which is the lowest price we've found at a reputable retailer:

  • iPhone Air 256GB $840 (originally $999)
  • iPhone Air 512GB $1,040 (originally $1,199)
  • iPhone Air 1TB $1,240 (originally $1,400)

We previously reported that Best Buy offered nearly $150 in savings across all iPhone Air models during its July Black Friday sale, but this time around the discounts are even deeper — across all three storage configurations and all colors.

Although Amazon was going toe-to-toe or better than Best Buy on most Apple pricing as this morning's sale went live, on iPhone Air it's Best Buy leading the way — Amazon doesn't officially sell the new unlocked variant.

If you want to grab the iPhone Air at an even lower price, consider checking Best Buy's 'Premium' open-box stock under the 'More Options' link on each configuration — we've tracked up to $350 or more in savings there.

  • Open-box iPhone Air 256GB Space Black $798 (originally $999)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Sky Blue $847 (originally $1,199)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Space Black $987 (originally $1,199)

M5 Pro MacBook Pro sees limited one-day $650 price drop

Although this is more of a niche, high-end configuration, you can find more affordable models at Amazon and Apple's certified refurbished store. We've just spotted a brand-new M5 Pro MacBook Pro at a stellar discount of $650 off.

B&H is now offering a massive $650 price drop on Apple's latest 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro. This configuration has 48GB of memory, 1TB of storage, an 18-core/20-core processor, and the Nano-Texture glass upgrade, priced at $3,099 with free shipping.

Yes, this MacBook is still not exactly cheap. But consider this: if you were to buy it directly from Apple, the MSRP on this machine is $3,749.

If you're looking to grab a high-performance, high-end MacBook Pro but don't want to test Apple's refurbished machines or Amazon's lower-spec models, B&H's limited-time one-day deal is absolutely worth considering.

Below are some of the more affordable MacBook models currently available at Apple's official refurbished store:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (originally $1,599 new) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 new) — $300 off
  • MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (originally $699 new)
  • MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (originally $799 new)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 new)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,549 (originally $2,999 new)
  • Space Black and Silver
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,059 (originally $3,599 new)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,719 (originally $3,199 new)

Grab a new MacBook Neo today and get a FREE $25 Starbucks gift card, or up to $120 off via Apple

Best Buy's 60th Anniversary Sale is now in full swing with thousands of discounts, 10x rewards for Plus/Total members, and more. In addition to this week's great deals on AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Max 2, and AirTag 2, Best Buy is also offering a FREE $25 Starbucks gift card with the purchase of a MacBook Neo (or you can forgo the gift and grab $120 off via Apple's refurbished store).

As part of the 60th Anniversary Sale, Best Buy is buying you a few Starbucks coffees with the purchase of a MacBook Neo starting from $699.

  • FREE $25 Starbucks gift card with the purchase of a MacBook Neo

Of course, this isn't the actual cash discount we'd hoped for, but considering that Apple's most affordable current-generation MacBook has almost never seen any deal pricing on new units, we think a free Starbucks is pretty good if you're considering.

That said, in my opinion, the best MacBook Neo deal across the web actually comes directly from Apple. The Neo recently saw a $100 price hike, but you can take the road less traveled and head to the official Renewed store for the best refurbished price on the web. There's no free coffee here, but units starting from $599 are available now, and the 512GB model is discounted by up to $120:

  • Apple Certified Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (originally $699 new)
  • Apple Certified Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (originally $799 new)

All of these machines come with:

  • Apple 1-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare eligibility
  • Rigorous Apple refurbishment process before sale

Most affordable M4 iPad Air drops $100, M3 models up to $400 off at Best Buy

Beyond Best Buy's 60th Anniversary Sale and AirPods Pro 3 still at one of their best prices ever, this morning also brought new lows on AirPods Max 2 with $120 off, and we're seeing the most affordable M4 iPad Air models discounted again by nearly $100 following the price hike. Best Buy is also offering $400 off M3 iPad Air models.

Amazon is now offering nearly $100 off a range of the most affordable M4 iPad Air models. These are the lowest prices we've tracked since the retail price hike — and you can also find discounts on some Wi-Fi + Cellular models:

***Note: With Best Buy's 60th Anniversary Sale, some models can be found for $1 more off.

M4 iPad Air 11-inch

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $650 (originally $749)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $749 (originally $849)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $949 (originally $1,049)

M4 iPad Air 13-inch

  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $850 (originally $949)
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $950 (originally $1,049)

While Best Buy's 60th Anniversary Sale discounts are roughly on par with Amazon for the latest M4 lineup, M3 iPad Air discounts go up to $400, and for most users the experience is nearly identical.

Although the most affordable M3 storage config is already sold out at Best Buy, you can now grab a 1TB M3 iPad Air for $50 less than the 256GB M4 Air.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Grab a pair of matte black Beats Solo Buds from just $41
  • Grab the latest 240W braided Beats USB-C cable starting from $18 with Amazon Prime shipping (40% off)
  • This Anker 8-outlet power strip with USB and surge protection is $22 today
  • Skip the desktop stand, HUANUO FlowLift Pro monitor arm is down to $25.50 (originally $50)
  • This travel-ready power strip with 65W USB-C charging is now $25 (save 31%)
  • Spigen adjustable lanyard wrist strap for phones, keys, or cameras now at $45 all-time low
  • Tool-free Grade 5 titanium Apple Watch bands in natural and black finishes now down to $70
  • Belkin's new compact 100W USB-C MacBook GaN charger with 5-foot cable now down to $25

AirPods 4 (ANC) hit their lowest price in 6 months at Amazon, now 25% off

While AirPods Pro 3 are still at 75% of MSRP and currently at $190, which is one of their lowest prices ever, Amazon has also dropped Apple's more affordable AirPods 4 (ANC) to around the best price in 6 months, going for 25% off.

Amazon is now discounting the AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation down to $134.99 with free shipping.

Originally $179 MSRP, this is a genuine 25% discount, and it's the best price we've found at a reputable retailer for new units.

  • AirPods 4 (ANC) $135 (originally $179)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)

While the base model AirPods 4 are still priced at $99, deals on Apple's most affordable current-generation AirPods have remained steady but stagnant. The base model has been at the $100 mark for several months now, and the ANC version has been roughly the same since we last saw a price below $149… until today.

AirPods 4 (ANC) — Apple's most affordable current-generation AirPods with Active Noise Cancellation — is now priced at its lowest at Amazon since early March 2026.

Although the next-generation AirPods may be among the few products spared from the memory and storage shortage-driven price hikes next month, it's hard to say for sure. Apple is likely preparing to add camera technology to a lineup that sounds Pro, and based on recent trends, the MSRP across the board could increase this time around. Either way, AirPods Pro with Active Noise Cancellation are now at one of the best prices of the year.
